Drag a tab along the row
behaviour: Dragging a tab along the tab row and dropping it there moves it to that place.

label: Resize a side pane
behaviour: Dragging the edge between the item list and the navigation, details or preview pane resizes that pane.

label: Tabs past the row's end
behaviour: When the tabs no longer fit, each shrinks to its narrow width and the tab list scrolls, with a scroll button at each end of it.

label: Linux entry
behaviour: With the Windows Subsystem for Linux installed, a Linux entry follows Network in the navigation pane; the reference machine has none installed.

Address bar
behaviour: Moves the focus into the address bar's edit form with the path selected.

label: Address bar
behaviour: Moves the focus into the address bar's edit form with the path selected, as Alt+D does.

label: Search box
behaviour: Moves the focus into the search box.

label: Address bar history
behaviour: Opens the address bar's edit form with its history list.

label: Preview pane
behaviour: Shows the preview pane, or hides it when it shows; it replaces the details pane.

label: Details pane
behaviour: Shows the details pane, or hides it when it shows; it replaces the preview pane.

label: New tab
behaviour: Opens a new tab on Home and switches to it.

label: Close tab
behaviour: Closes the current tab; with one tab left it closes the window.

label: New window
behaviour: Opens a new File Explorer window.

label: Back
behaviour: Goes back to the previous folder.

label: Forward
behaviour: Goes forward again after Back.

label: Up
behaviour: Goes to the folder that holds this one.

label: Next pane
behaviour: Moves the focus to the next part of the window, in a cycle: item list, status bar, tab row, navigation pane.

label: Drag a tab out
behaviour: Dropping a dragged tab outside the tab row opens it in a window of its own.
